name: Palm alcohol
description: Palm alcohol (CAS 93762-75-5 ), derived from palm oil fatty acids, is a mixture of long-chain fatty alcohols used across personal care, food, and cleaning formulations. It functions primarily as an emulsifier, thickener, and conditioning agent, providing texture and stability to finished products. In cosmetics and personal care, palm alcohol is incorporated into creams, lotions, and hair conditioners where it builds viscosity and stabilizes oil-in-water emulsions. Home care formulators use it to improve the rheology and spreadability of fabric softeners and surface cleaning products. In food-grade applications, it serves as an emulsification aid and carrier in certain processed food systems. Industrial cleaning formulations rely on it to control foam behavior and enhance the consistency of liquid detergent concentrates. Palm alcohol is supplied as a waxy solid or flakes at ambient temperature, with melting point characteristics suited to bulk handling and hot-process manufacturing. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades, with specifications aligned to industry requirements. The material is processed to ensure high purity and consistent fatty alcohol composition across batches. Packaging options typically include bags, fiber drums, and bulk containers to accommodate both small-batch formulators and large-scale production needs. This versatile ingredient remains a staple for manufacturers seeking sustainable, plant-derived alternatives for texture modification. Its chemical stability and compatibility with various surfactants make it an essential component in modern chemical formulation and industrial processing.
